description: Brief controls (Goldman Sachs 'AI Control Layer') mapped to existing vitest tests by full name. Run: npm run test:controls.

rows.control: Central policy; a new version applies to the next request; strict turns the review band into BLOCK

allow.test: policy update activates a validated new version with trusted identity and content hashes

block.test: decide maps the review band to BLOCK only in strict mode
executeChat 17. a version mismatch is unavailable before any claim
policy update rejects analyst before persistence

rows.control: Import blocks or redacts unsafe units and publishes only clean facts

allow.test: executeImport publishes an all-clean batch as approved/ALLOW, one Laya call per non-blank line

block.test: executeImport removes a signature-blocked unit without a Laya call: partial/REDACT with its locator
executeImport (upload) MIX-01: removes the contact, credential and injected lines and publishes the fact: partial/REDACT
executeImport (upload) removes every line of a row holding a PEM block, key body included: BLOCK

rows.control: Feed signatures match after NFKC, zero-width removal and on subdomains

allow.test: matchSignatures needs a dot boundary for domains

block.test: matchSignatures matches SIG-001 after NFKC and case folding
matchSignatures is not evaded by extra whitespace or zero-width characters
matchSignatures matches SIG-002 on a subdomain inside a URL
executeChat 2. a signature BLOCK calls no provider and reserves nothing

rows.control: Secrets and contact data in model output are blocked; the value never leaves

allow.test: matchSensitive finds nothing in a benign sentence or a word that only contains a prefix

block.test: executeChat 11c. a credential in the answer is a BLOCK at output_signature; the token never leaves
matchSensitive finds keys, token prefixes and emails with category and code, never the value
matchSensitive covers each conventional prefix and survives a zero-width split

rows.control: Origin check, 401 without session, strict body, identical 404 for unauthorised ids

allow.test: handle runs with the parsed body and key, with no-store

block.test: handle rejects a foreign or missing Origin before identity
handle maps no session to 401 and an identity outage to 503, never ALLOW
handle validates key, content type, size and strict body before running
readExcerpt answers an id outside the actor's permissions exactly as an id that does not exist

rows.control: Laya bands: ALLOW below review, REVIEW band (Qwen verification), BLOCK above; policy BLOCK is final

allow.test: executeChat 1. ALLOW runs the full sequence and releases only after finalize
sends only the policy REVIEW band to the verifier, and passes ALLOW through

block.test: executeChat 4. the review band holds in balanced mode and blocks in strict mode
executeChat 3. a semantic BLOCK on the input never generates
keeps a policy BLOCK final below the verification ceiling (no verifier call)
executeChat verification cannot clear a policy-block denial

rows.control: Reserve before the provider call; an exhausted budget blocks first; unknown usage is not zero

allow.test: standalone guard assessment records intent and reserves before live assessment, then persists before allow

block.test: executeChat 13. an exhausted budget blocks before any provider call
executeChat 6. a detection failure leaves the reservation unresolved
the usage totals lets one unknown make the total unknown, rather than understating it

rows.control: Pinned Laya revision and Qwen digest; a mismatch withholds

allow.test: G2 detection factory returns schema-valid single-window metadata and genuine aggregate usage

block.test: executeChat 12. a wrong Laya revision or Qwen digest is unavailable
G2 detection factory wrong revision blocks inference; revision drift retains consumed usage
G2 generation factory rejects malformed output and wrong digest safely

rows.control: File type decided by content: CSV accepted; PDF and binary (pickle) refused with 415

allow.test: startUpload creates an unverified source, quarantines the raw bytes, then a pending run: 202

block.test: startUpload refuses a PDF by its magic bytes with an honest 415, whatever its name
startUpload refuses pickle bytes named .csv with 415 UNSUPPORTED_FILE before storing anything

rows.control: No code-execution tools: model tool calls refused; shell, hidden paths and traversal denied

allow.test: accepts a bounded prompt from a hook-scoped bearer and returns the gateway envelope

block.test: executeChat 10. a proposed tool call is refused
strict guard inputs allows small source edits but denies shell, hidden paths, traversal and protected config
marks shell execution as a deterministic denial and sends no shell command to the model

allow.test: strict guard inputs allows small source edits but denies shell, hidden paths, traversal and protected config

block.test: strict guard inputs allows small source edits but denies shell, hidden paths, traversal and protected config
strict guard inputs rejects caller identity, unknown fields and oversized edits

rows.control: MCP exposes public data only, behind a scoped bearer token

allow.test: InterLock MCP route using the official SDK client discovers only the two fixed tools and calls both through a public credential

block.test: InterLock MCP route using the official SDK client requires bearer identity before discovery and rejects foreign origins
InterLock MCP route using the official SDK client never emits a public excerpt when its output assessment refuses it
integration bearer identity rejects malformed, missing, wrong-scope, revoked, expired and inactive credentials

rows.control: Client actions: role limits, delete held for approval, injection in action fields blocked

allow.test: Act mode happy path: an analyst's create is ALLOW, written once under the run id

block.test: Act mode an employee's create is BLOCK from the role rules, with the refusal's trace
Act mode an admin's delete is REVIEW and never deletes
Act mode an analyst's +30% fee change is REVIEW, held by clients.ts, nothing written
client_create blocks an injection or a contact in any text field with its reason code and writes nothing

rows.control: A missing or failing required component answers 503 with no reservation

allow.test: executeChat 1. ALLOW runs the full sequence and releases only after finalize

block.test: executeChat 7. a missing detection adapter is 503 with no reservation
executeChat 7b. a missing generation adapter is 503 with no reservation
executeImport without a composed detection adapter: 503 before any reservation, failed, nothing published
unavailableResponse returns a valid 503 envelope with no decision

rows.control: Audit export capped and scoped; blocked, loop and review counters kept separate

allow.test: exportAudit answers CSV with a trace id, own scope and the current UTC day by default
the counters keeps blocked attempts, loop stops and review cases apart

block.test: exportAudit exports exactly the cap and refuses one more with a narrowing instruction
exportAudit gives an admin the organisation, and refuses it to anyone else
the response refuses a window larger than one read can total

not_implemented.note: Unsafe chat output is withheld (BLOCK/REVIEW), never partially redacted; redaction exists only on import.
The generation model is a pinned constant, not a configurable allowlist.
POST/PUT /feeds answers 503; the feed is read-only in this build.
Phone, IBAN, PESEL and card numbers are not detected; only email contact data is.
Per-stage timing not asserted by a test; the audit test asserts the stage sequence and only the generation call's duration.
